25		switch v {
26		case Public:
27			return "PUBLIC"
28		case Protected:
29			return "PROTECTED"
30		default:
31			return "PRIVATE"
32		}
33	}

36		// ID is the system generated unique identifier for the memo.
37		ID int32

39		UID string

91	}

94		ID         int32
95		UID        *string
96		CreatedTs  *int64
97		UpdatedTs  *int64
98		RowStatus  *RowStatus
99		Content    *string

109	func (s *Store) CreateMemo(ctx context.Context, create *Memo) (*Memo, error) {
110		if !base.UIDMatcher.MatchString(create.UID) {
111			return nil, errors.New("invalid uid")
112		}
113		return s.driver.CreateMemo(ctx, create)
114	}
115	
116	func (s *Store) ListMemos(ctx context.Context, find *FindMemo) ([]*Memo, error) {
117		return s.driver.ListMemos(ctx, find)
118	}
119	
120	func (s *Store) GetMemo(ctx context.Context, find *FindMemo) (*Memo, error) {
121		list, err := s.ListMemos(ctx, find)
122		if err != nil {
123			return nil, err
124		}
125		if len(list) == 0 {
126			return nil, nil
127		}
128	
129		memo := list[0]
130		return memo, nil
131	}
132	
133	func (s *Store) UpdateMemo(ctx context.Context, update *UpdateMemo) error {
134		if update.UID != nil && !base.UIDMatcher.MatchString(*update.UID) {
135			return errors.New("invalid uid")
136		}
137		return s.driver.UpdateMemo(ctx, update)
138	}
139	
140	func (s *Store) DeleteMemo(ctx context.Context, delete *DeleteMemo) error {
141		// Clean up memo_relation records where this memo is either the source or target.
142		if err := s.driver.DeleteMemoRelation(ctx, &DeleteMemoRelation{MemoID: &delete.ID}); err != nil {
143			return err
144		}
145		if err := s.driver.DeleteMemoRelation(ctx, &DeleteMemoRelation{RelatedMemoID: &delete.ID}); err != nil {
146			return err
147		}
148		// Clean up attachments linked to this memo.
149		attachments, err := s.ListAttachments(ctx, &FindAttachment{MemoID: &delete.ID})
150		if err != nil {
151			return err
152		}
153		for _, attachment := range attachments {
154			if err := s.DeleteAttachment(ctx, &DeleteAttachment{ID: attachment.ID}); err != nil {
155				return err
156			}
157		}
158		return s.driver.DeleteMemo(ctx, delete)
159	}
